{{Top|leg}}
'''Eeookko''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[244Core]].<ref name="Unknown">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>

==Characteristics==
Eeookko was home to [[Eeook Corporation]]'s southern regional office, and was one of the most productive mining centers on the entire southern hemisphere of [[244Core]].<ref name="Unknown" /> Located in [[Zone 210]], Eeookko sat in the center of an enormous crater, 120 kilometers across, that was made thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Eeookko made good use of this crater; the impact exposed veins of precious metals, as well as exotic ore introduced by the steroid itself.<ref name="Unknown" /> However, because this region was struck by meteorites more than other locations, the majority of Eeookko - including the city's critical facilities and living quarters - was located more than five kilometers underground.<ref name="Unknown" /> Only about five percent of the city was located on the surface.<ref name="Unknown" />
